description: issue #739 (Epic Gate finding B3 on epic #660): with `sprites` active, `tell`/`ask`/`each` are profile reserved words, so binding any of them as a VARIABLE raises `ol-reserved-word` — the third of the three cases spec/turtles-and-sprites.md:154 names ("programs MUST NOT redefine them as variables, procedures, or struct constructors"), and the one that was unmet while `sprites` was already claimed. #679's reserved-procedures-*/reserved-struct-* fixtures cover the procedure and struct constructor cases; this pair covers the variable case, across the three surface forms that create one: assignment's colon-place (`:tell = 1`), its bare-place spelling (`set ask to 2`), and a `for … in` binder (`for each in …`). One diagnostic per binding, each pointing at the bound name with `namespace` `reserved`. Paired with reserved-bindings-without-sprites, which semantically CHECKS this exact source under Core alone and is clean: together they prove the rule is gated on the active profile, not unconditional. `"check": true` (semantic-checker only, no execution) because this is a checker rule — no sprite is ever created and no events are produced.

diagnostics.message: tell is already a reserved, so it can't be redefined here.
ask is already a reserved, so it can't be redefined here.
each is already a reserved, so it can't be redefined here.
